rows: Right! Okay, let us get going, this is brilliant!
Brawling? Yes, I can do that, watch this!
A risk? Bring it on, I love a bit of danger!
Slow? Not for me, I am all energy!
The people are amazing, let us give them something big!
I am so ready I could burst!
I have been dreaming about this for ages, honestly!
Look at this stance! Ready, set, go!
You talk about technique? Watch my moves instead!
Strikes are fun! Quick, sharp, fun!
A risk is a thrill, and I am thrilled!
A stall? Boring! Let us move!
The people want fireworks! I have some!
You say you are among the best? Show me the moves!
You are proud of your strength? Great, let us see it fly!
I have seen your strength, and it looks amazing!
You kept calm? Good, I am not calm at all!
Fair! I like that, let us go!
I could tell you off, but there is no time!
One fall! Keep me down, I dare you!
On the mat, I will bounce around you. Keep up!
Grounded or standing, I am still flying!
Stay in front of me, and let us see the magic!
Good answer! Now do something bigger!
You have not answered! Come on, answer!
Fair point! I will try it in the air!
I accept that! Let us fly at the bell!
I will give this match everything, with a bit of flair!
My approach is bold and bright. You will see it on the night!
Whatever happens, it will be spectacular!
It is not finished! There is a big finish coming!
I have one more trick. You will see it when the bell rings!
